This Privacy Statement applies to all related websites (hereinafter referred to as the "Site") owned or operated by TPIsoftware Corporation and its affiliates (including TPIsoftware Company Limited, TPIsoftware PTE. LTD, TPIsoftware CO., LTD., TPIsoftware Co., Ltd., TPIsoftware <span lang="ja">株式會社</span>, Alpaca Vietnam Company Limited, and domestic and overseas subsidiaries newly added due to organizational changes announced in the future; hereinafter collectively referred to as "TPIsoftware") and entrusted to GoodAds Corporation (hereinafter referred to as "G.A.D.") for operation.

TPIsoftware values and respects your personal privacy and personal data protection. To protect your rights and interests, TPIsoftware hereby informs you of the following matters in accordance with Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Personal Data Protection Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan) and relevant laws and regulations:

## 1. Purposes of Personal Data Collection

According to the "Specific Purposes and Categories of Personal Data under the Personal Data Protection Act", the purposes for which the Site collects personal data include:

- 013 Public Relations
- 040 Marketing
- 063 Collection, processing, and use of personal data by non-public agencies in accordance with legal obligations
- 075 Science and Technology Administration
- 098 Commercial and Technical Information
- 109 Education or Training Administration
- 110 Industry-Academia Cooperation
- 123 Trade Promotion and Management
- 125 Communication Administration and Management
- 133 Operation of telecommunications business and telecommunications value-added network business
- 135 Information (and Communication) Services
- 136 Information (and Communication) and Database Management
- 137 Information and Communication Security and Management
- 157 Investigation, Statistics, and Research Analysis
- 181 Other operations corresponding to the business scope specified in the business registration or articles of incorporation

## 2. Categories of Personal Data Collected

According to the "Specific Purposes and Categories of Personal Data under the Personal Data Protection Act", the categories of personal data collected by the Site include:

- C01 Individuals identifying
- C011 Personal description
- C035 Leisure activities and interests
- C038 Occupation
- C051 School records
- C052 Qualifications or skills
- C054 Professional expertise
- C061 Current employment status

## 3. Period, Region, Target Entities, and Manner of Personal Data Use

- Period of Use: The period of personal data use is limited to the duration of the aforementioned specific purposes of collection, or until the date you request to cease use or TPIsoftware and G.A.D. terminate service provision.
- Region of Use: To facilitate TPIsoftware’s global operations and service provision, TPIsoftware may transmit and access your personal data to countries or regions within or outside the Republic of China (Taiwan) where TPIsoftware is located or has operational sites, and use it within the scope of the aforementioned purposes in accordance with this Privacy Statement.
- Target Entities of Use: TPIsoftware Corporation and its affiliates (including TPIsoftware Company Limited, TPIsoftware PTE. LTD, TPIsoftware CO., LTD., TPIsoftware Co., Ltd., TPIsoftware <span lang="ja">株式會社</span>, Alpaca Vietnam Company Limited, and domestic and overseas subsidiaries newly added due to organizational changes announced in the future; hereinafter collectively referred to as "TPIsoftware"), GoodAds Corporation (hereinafter referred to as "G.A.D."), AISO alliance and all its current and future members,as well as mandated institutions and contractors entrusted by TPIsoftware or G.A.D. to handle affairs.
- Manner of Use: TPIsoftware and G.A.D. will collect, process, and use your personal data through automated or non-automated means in compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
- Website Analytics and Use of Cookie Technology: The Site may utilize third-party analytics tools (such as Google Analytics) and Cookie technology to analyze website traffic, optimize user experience, and evaluate marketing effectiveness. You may disable or delete Cookies at any time through your browser settings; such settings will not affect your browsing and use of the core services of the Site.

## 4. Rights of Data Subjects and Exercise Methods

According to Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), you may exercise the following rights regarding your personal data retained by TPIsoftware and G.A.D.:

- Inquire or request to view your personal data.
- Request a copy of your personal data.
- Request to supplement or correct your personal data.
- Request to discontinue collection, processing, or use of your personal data.
- Request deletion of your personal data.

If you wish to exercise the above rights, or have any questions regarding the personal data protection matters of TPIsoftware and G.A.D., please contact us via email: service@aisoportal.com

Upon receiving your request, TPIsoftware and G.A.D. will verify your identity in accordance with the law and handle it properly within the statutory time limit.

## 5. Impact of Non-Provision of Personal Data on Rights and Interests

You are free to choose whether to provide your personal data. However, if you choose not to provide personal data, or provide incomplete or inaccurate personal data, TPIsoftware and G.A.D. will be unable to carry out necessary processing for your requests or provide you with complete services.

## 6. Links to Other Sites

The Site may contain links to other third-party websites ("Linked Sites"). Such Linked Sites are not under the control of TPIsoftware or G.A.D., and their personal data and privacy protection are governed by the privacy policies of such Linked Sites, which fall outside the scope of this Privacy Statement. You should review the privacy policies of such Linked Sites on your own.

## 7. Changes to This Privacy Statement

TPIsoftware reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to change, modify, add, or remove portions of this Privacy Statement at any time. All changes shall become effective immediately upon being posted on the Site without separate notice. You are responsible for regularly checking this Privacy Statement for changes.

The English version of this Privacy Statement is for reference only. In the event of any discrepancy, the Chinese version shall prevail.

This Privacy Statement and any information on this Site are subject to change without notice.
